text.aria-label: Title text 'Net power and three forecasts in a summer and a winter week'

g.text: Net power and three forecasts in a summer and a winter week

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly net power as a percentage of each site's effective capacity (negative is export). Forecast lines are the median of each frozen fit's forecast, made with data to 30 June 2025. Black: measured. Orange: convex model, 12 months. Blue: convex model, all years with drift. Purple: XGBoost, all years, with the solar offset.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly net power as a percentage of each site's effective capacity (negative is export).
Forecast lines are the median of each frozen fit's forecast, made with data to 30 June 2025.
Black: measured. Orange: convex model, 12 months. Blue: convex model, all years with drift.
Purple: XGBoost, all years, with the solar offset.
